summary: Frontend-only regression + new features (waveform, jingles, voice tracking, weekly schedule, hotkey isolation) all tested end-to-end against preview URL. 100% pass across the 8 target flows. Only console warning noticed: a benign React hydration warning from the crossfade <select> inside PlayerBar where an unsupported <span> wraps <option> children (appears injected by editor tooling x-ve-dynamic wrapper, not user code) — not a functional bug.

issues: Console warns: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning; comes from build-time editor wrapper injected around array-mapped <option> children. Cosmetic/console-only; select still works.

critical_code_review_comments: VoiceRecorder.save() catches all errors silently — if decodeAudioData fails the user only sees error UI with no cause. Consider logging the error.

JingleBar hidden <input> targetIndex is stored in a ref that lives across dialogs — if the pad click is not followed by file selection the ref stays pointing to that index; next unrelated file-input change would still work correctly because onChange resets it, but relying on click-then-set order is a UX pitfall for future E2E scripts.
ScheduleModal: choosing zero days shows 'none = every day' which is fine, but no validation that end > start.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created 'Test Show' playlist with 2 generated WAV tracks, one jingle pad assignment, one voice-recorded track, and a weekly schedule (Mon/Wed/Fri 08:30–10:00). Verified persistence across a full page reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://dj-playout-studio.preview.emergentagent.com . All 8 requested flows PASS: (1) create playlist + upload 2 WAVs + play + next/prev + persistence, (2) main waveform present on player-bar and click-to-seek changes current-time, (3) Jingle assign requires clicking the pad FIRST then set_input_files on jingle-file-input (works), (4) Jingle click plays over music without changing player-track-name; keyboard Digit1 fires with no crash; jingle-stop-all works, (5) Jingle clear returns pad to 'Pad 1' state, (6) Voice tracking modal opens, MediaRecorder works in headless Chromium after context.grant_permissions(['microphone']), preview toggle + name + insert-position appear, save inserts track at chosen index (track-count 2→3, row1 name='Voice Track HH:MM AM/PM.wav'), (7) Schedule save writes badge '08:30–10:00' and persists Mon/Wed/Fri across reload (days {1,3,5} active), (8) Digits/space typed into new-playlist-input are captured by the input and do NOT trigger playback or jingles. Note: ScheduleModal only closes via backdrop mouseDown or its X button — Escape key does not close it; if a test needs to close it, click the backdrop or the header X.
